title: Rain on a tilted street
process: rain on a plane running off its foot: steady outflow, steady depth, time to steady state
executor: node (CPU surface solver) and browser (GPU); raw measurements in street/raw/, scored by run.mjs
equations: continuity at steady state: Q = i A
kinematic wave on a plane: h_t + (alpha h^m)_x = i, alpha = sqrt(S0)/n, m = 5/3
steady depth h(x) = (i x / alpha)^(3/5); time of concentration t_c = h(L)/i; rising outflow q(L,t)/(i L) = (t/t_c)^(5/3)
kinematic wave number k = S0 L / (h_L Fr^2) (the approximation is used only where k > 20)
boundaryConditions: walls on three sides; the foot (east) is the solver's free-outfall edge (Manning velocity on the water-surface slope, at most critical), the app's edge for every real model. Rain constant from t = 0.
geometry: a plane falling east from a divide: SS1-a 100 x 8 m at 1 %, n 0.015; SS1-b 60 x 8 m at 2 %, n 0.016 (the app's street roughness); 1 m cells

cases.unit: rain mm/h and min; times s; probe x m from the divide (cell centres)

solver: FloodSim surface solver with the app's settings (hdry 1e-5 m, hfront 1e-3 m, dtDry 2 s; MUSCL minmod, HLLC, SSP-RK2, CFL 0.48). cpu rows: src/solver-cpu.js (fp64). gpu rows: src/solver-gpu.js in Chrome WebGPU (fp32).

reference.sources: Henderson, Open Channel Flow (1966) sec. 9.6; Woolhiser & Liggett (1967) Water Resources Research 3(3) for the range of the kinematic approximation
reference.independence: closed forms from the rain rate, slope, roughness and length alone
reference.crossCheck: refs.test.mjs: an explicit upwind solution of the kinematic wave gives the same steady depth (1 %) and times to 50 % and 90 % (2 %)

outputs: steady outflow (mean over the last 300 s)
steady depth at the two probes (t = 1200 s)
time to 50 % and to 90 % of steady outflow
criteriaNotes: Outflow = rain x area is continuity, so 1 %. Depth and timing are scored against the kinematic wave, which leaves out the pressure and inertia terms the solver keeps: 5 % on depth and 10 % on the times allow for that at k > 100 (both cases), and for outflow sampled every 5 s. Books: round-off for fp64, 1e-5 for the GPU (fp32, the level its other benchmarks close to).
conservation: surface books: stored = rain - edge outflow
assumptions: the free-outfall edge does not hold water back on a slope this steep (checked by the steady depths upstream of it)
limitations: the kinematic wave is an approximation of the equations solved, not an exact solution of them
a plane: no gutter, crown or kerb
validRange: sheet flow on planes at 1-2 % with k > 20; depths of 4-10 mm
scoring: automated: street/score.mjs builds rows with lib/score.mjs row(); one row set per executor (cpu, gpu), never merged; a case with no raw file is listed as not run and has no rows

criteriaRevisions.why: first registration, before any sandbox case was run
